words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}) opens the ayah as a completed perfect: the origin statement is given as an accomplished act, and the active form keeps the acting Lord recoverable from 96:1 without repeating the subject. The verb is no longer the absolute creation statement of 96:1; here it takes {{ar:ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ}} ({{tr:al-insāna}}) as object and {{ar:مِنْ عَلَقٍ}} ({{tr:min ʿalaqin}}) as source, so the broad creation formula is narrowed into a patient-and-material frame. The {{ar:خ ل ق}} ({{tr:kh-l-q}}) family also carries measuring and proportioning pressure, so this is not bare making from material but ordered origination; the fabrication branch remains a contrast, since the local Form I frame presents genuine creation rather than invented speech. Structurally, the ayah shifts from the command of 96:1 into declarative exposition, and that completed act becomes the ground from which the renewed command in 96:3 can be heard. The local creation-clinging pair compresses an embryological field found in fuller sequence passages such as 22:5, 23:14, 40:67, and 75:38 into one short clause; the repeated qaf closure with {{ar:عَلَقٍ}} ({{tr:ʿalaqin}}) lets the creating act and the final material source be heard together without making them the same root.

topics.headline: completed active act with recoverable agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the creation statement is presented as an accomplished act while the acting Lord from 96:1 remains grammatically present without being restated.
topics.reason: QAC marks a 3ms perfect active verb, and attachment evidence licenses the implicit subject from the prior creator description in 96:1.

topics.headline: absolute creation becomes object-and-source creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices progressive disclosure: the repeated creation verb now names both the human patient and the clinging material source.
topics.reason: The local frame has an explicit direct object and a governed source complement, turning the earlier absolute creation mention into a specified act.

topics.headline: measured origination with fabrication kept as contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb can carry ordered forming and proportioning pressure, while the local Form I creation frame prevents the fabrication branch from becoming the selected sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports measuring, originating, and fabrication as distinct root branches; local Form I with human object and source material selects genuine measured origination and keeps fabricated speech only as a contrast.

topics.headline: command pivots into explanatory declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not continue with another imperative; it grounds the reading command of 96:1 in a completed creative act before the command returns in 96:3.
topics.reason: The first-position perfect verb creates a declarative clause whose object and source detail the prior creation attribute and prepare the renewed command.

topics.headline: sound links act to material endpoint

topics.reason: The creation-clinging pairing is locally licensed by the source complement, and the qaf closure is a sound observation rather than a semantic merger.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ}} ({{tr:al-insāna}}) is the accusative object of {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}), so the ayah names what the prior creation statement left open: the human species is the created patient. Its definite singular form works generically, treating humanity as one known category rather than distributing the claim across many individuals. Positionally, the noun stands between the creating act and {{ar:مِنْ عَلَقٍ}} ({{tr:min ʿalaqin}}), making the recognized human product the hinge before the indefinite source material is disclosed. In recitation, the liaison after the verb softens the sound boundary at the same point where grammar binds act to patient. The human term then becomes a same-surah thread: the created human of 96:2 is the one taught in 96:5 and the one who overreaches in 96:6. The contested derivational pressure is useful but bounded: sociality and forgetfulness can sharpen the portrait of the human who must remember origin, while local grammar still selects the generic human noun. In the wider creation-human formula, this ayah humbles the familiar category by immediately attaching it to clinging material, even as 95:4 can view the same human creature through excellent proportion.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment identify the noun as accusative direct object, and the definite singular supports a generic species reading.

topics.headline: human product stands before source material

topics.reason: The word order places the direct object between the verb and the source phrase, while definiteness contrasts with the following indefinite noun.

topics.headline: sociality and forgetfulness sharpen the human term

topics.reason: V4 has no guardrail rows for this root, so the coherent contested-derivation claim is preserved cautiously as pressure, not as a replacement for the local generic noun.

topics.headline: singular form carries species-wide reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one compact singular form can carry a species-wide claim instead of requiring a plural people-form.
topics.reason: The local definite singular is grammatically compatible with generic species reference.

topics.headline: created human becomes the surah's tracked participant

topics.reason: The co-occurrence profile supports the familiar creation-human association, while the local source phrase supplies the material narrowing; 95:4 is a valid supplied contrast.

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is the small word that makes the source relation explicit. It attaches {{ar:عَلَقٍ}} ({{tr:ʿalaqin}}) to {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}), governs the following noun, and marks the clinging matter as material origin rather than a second object. Origin is the selected local force, while partitive and specification pressures remain helpful because the phrase says the human is from, out of, and materially identified by the source. Its independent written form leaves a visible boundary before the final noun; after {{ar:خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa al-insāna}}), the particle launches the second beat and delays the material disclosure until the close. The final nasal of the particle also answers the tanwīn of {{ar:عَلَقٍ}} ({{tr:ʿalaqin}}), audibly binding source marker to source noun.

topics.headline: particle governs the material source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source phrase is grammatically governed by the particle and belongs to the creation event, not merely to the adjacent noun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following noun a governed source complement of the creation verb.

topics.headline: origin selected with partitive and specifying pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that material origin is the main relation, but the particle also lets the source feel like the material specification from which the human is constituted.
topics.reason: The local syntax selects a source-origin complement, so partitive and specification pressures are retained as reinforcing nuances rather than alternative parses.

topics.headline: independent particle opens the final beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the material source is delayed and introduced as its own final unit, making the origin phrase the ayah's landing rather than an incidental add-on.
topics.reason: The separate preposition begins the postposed source phrase after the object, creating a visible transition into biological material specificity.

topics.headline: nasal sound binds particle to noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sound reinforces the same dependency the grammar states: source marker and source noun are heard as a pair.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is locally tied to the governed prepositional phrase.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَقٍ}} ({{tr:ʿalaqin}}) closes the ayah as an indefinite genitive source noun. Because {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) governs it, the word is material origin, not a second patient beside {{ar:ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ}} ({{tr:al-insāna}}); because it is indefinite, the source is presented as a category of clinging matter rather than a named familiar object. The {{ar:ع ل ق}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-q}}) field keeps adhesion, clotted blood, leech-like clinging, and bond language in view, but local grammar keeps the selected sense material and embryonic rather than a free abstraction of relationship. Its collective-looking form and rarity matter: this is the marked non-unit source shape, not simply the more individuated clot-stage form used in other embryological passages. Those sequence passages can include staged development (22:5; 23:14; 40:67; 75:38), while 96:2 compresses the origin into one final term. The clause therefore descends from creating act to human category to dependent matter, and the last word makes clinging origin the element left ringing. It also ties the nurturing Lord and reading command of 96:1 to the human's dependent bodily origin, so gathered speech is grounded in a being first named through adhesion. Its qaf ending answers the qaf close of 96:1 and the local {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}), while the deep-to-stopped texture strengthens the clinging image without replacing the lexical evidence.

topics.headline: indefinite governed noun marks source material
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun is not another object but a generalized source category governed by the preposition.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun as genitive under the source preposition, while its indefiniteness generalizes the material.

topics.headline: adhesion field colors material origin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the material origin is not inert substance; it is named through a clinging and attachment field, while the local phrase prevents the word from becoming only an abstract relationship.
topics.reason: V4 supports clinging, clotted blood, leech-like attachment, and bond branches; the governed source phrase selects material origin and preserves attachment pressure as local image.

topics.headline: marked form differs from unit clot forms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends with a rare collective-looking source form, making the origin category feel broad and marked rather than one routine unit noun.
topics.reason: The supplied rarity and form notes are not contradicted by local grammar; they reinforce the final noun's broad source-category function.

topics.headline: developmental sequences compressed into one origin term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that passages with fuller developmental sequences, including 22:5, 23:14, 40:67, and 75:38, are compressed here into one closing source noun.
topics.reason: The local creation-source pairing supports a compact embryological register, while the cross-references remain echoes and do not impose their full sequence on 96:2.

topics.headline: ayah lands on dependent material origin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause does not end with the human product; it ends by leaving dependent clinging matter as the final retained image.
topics.reason: The word closes the four-word clause as the source complement, after the creating act and human object have already been named.

topics.headline: qaf and texture reinforce the final image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sound links the final material word to the creation wording and to the prior ayah's qaf closure (96:1), while the meanings remain distinct.
topics.reason: The sound observations are locally anchored in repeated qaf closures and do not collapse the distinct roots or grammatical roles.

topics.headline: dependent origin bridges Lordship and recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final material word links the nurturing Lord and reading command of 96:1 to the human's dependent bodily origin.
topics.reason: The boundary claims are coherent because 96:2 continues the creator-Lord frame of 96:1 and grounds the command context in material origin.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction خَلَقَ ... مِنْ عَلَقٍ links the human object directly to an attached, developing origin.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation carries a conception that has taken hold into visible human presence. The source is therefore not inert material alone but an already relational state: one thing subsists by fastening within another while formation begins.

activation_trace.role: Bringing one thing into being from another supplies the originating transition.
Conception taking hold supplies the concrete dependent starting state.
Visible human presence supplies the emergent endpoint of the transition.

changed_reading.before: A human is simply made from a clotlike substance.
changed_reading.after: The ayah compresses a transition in which conception takes hold and visible human presence is brought forth from that dependent beginning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقَ and عَلَقٍ can be read together as measured formation operating on something that clings.
baseline_models.mechanism: Proportioning does not erase dependence; it progressively gives balanced form to what is still attached. Human form is thus an achieved organization of a clinging relation rather than an autonomous block assembled from outside.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and apportioning supplies the formative operation.
Completion and balanced visible form supplies the operation's bodily result.
Clinging or hanging on another supplies the relational material being formed.

changed_reading.before: Creation names an undifferentiated act that precedes a finished human.
changed_reading.after: Creation is measured formation: dependent attachment is proportioned toward a complete human form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ and source noun عَلَقٍ both carry relational branch images.
baseline_models.mechanism: Familiarity that removes estrangement and affection that fastens to the heart allow the material origin to cast a relational anthropology: a human is made not only from attached matter but with attachment and sociability as constitutive conditions.

activation_trace.role: Familiar comfort that removes estrangement supplies the human's social mode.
Affection clinging to the heart supplies an affective form of attachment.
Inner disposition supplies a way for created form to include relational character.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports only the biological material from which an individual was made.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also image human being as constituted through attachment, familiarity, and an inward capacity for relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَلَقٍ can image the little sustenance by which life barely holds, while مِنْ marks that condition as origin.
baseline_models.mechanism: The human begins from a support that is small yet sufficient to keep life going. The origin statement therefore carries economic and existential precarity alongside embryonic materiality.

activation_trace.role: Meager sustenance that keeps life going supplies the image of minimal support.
Bringing into being from another thing makes that scant support an origin rather than an incidental later need.

changed_reading.before: The source material is lowly but otherwise self-contained.
changed_reading.after: The human is originated within radical need, held alive by a minimal provision that is not self-generated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conception-taking-hold baseline becomes a process of collection and nurture. A womb that gathers a fetus and a non-dominant mapped image of feeding and growth make عَلَقٍ the held beginning of development, while measured creation remains the formative operation.

activation_trace.role: Conception taking hold supplies the focus-stage that the context develops.
Measured apportioning supplies formation within the held process.
The womb gathering a pregnancy supplies an enclosure that collects the attached beginning.
The repeated womb-gathering branch makes gestational collection a recurring contextual echo.
The split-root image of feeding and growth supplies the developmental continuation.

structural_cues: The repeated ٱقْرَأْ at 96:1 and 96:3 encloses the focus ayah.
The creation verb in 96:1 runs directly into the more specific human origin in 96:2.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb-gathering, conception-taking-hold, measure, and feeding-growth images; I infer their temporal ordering into gestation. Ordinary reading and lordship remain live and need not be replaced by this additional echo.

changed_reading.before: عَلَقٍ identifies one static embryonic substance.
changed_reading.after: عَلَقٍ is a held inception within a gathered, measured, and nurtured gestational process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading, naming as visible marking, knowledge as a distinguishing sign, and the pared writing instrument activate an inscription analogy for measured creation. The human formed from attachment becomes a perceptible, differentiable, teachable being rather than merely a completed organism.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the formal operation analogous to composing a legible sign.
Perceiving something into awareness supplies the human capacity and condition of legibility.
Reading and recitation supply the act that receives what has become legible.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible identifying mark turns naming into differentiation.
A distinguishing sign that guides supplies knowledge as recognizable marking.
Cutting and paring a hard thing to level it supplies the material craft behind inscription.
The pared writing reed makes the mark-making mechanism explicit.

structural_cues: 96:1-5 sequences creation, name, repeated reading, teaching, pen, and the human who did not know.
The focus human is repeated as the recipient of teaching in 96:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reading, an identifying mark, a guiding sign, a pared pen, perception, and measured formation; I supply the analogy between bodily formation and inscription. A simpler sequence of physical creation followed by teaching remains equally live.

changed_reading.before: 96:2 supplies a biological preface to a separate discussion of reading and teaching.
changed_reading.after: 96:2 also begins the making of a readable and reading human, whose measured form becomes perceptible, differentiable, and teachable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation becomes an ethical boundary. The leveling cut sharpens the sense of proportion; transgression appears both as crossing a limit and as overwhelming water; reaching an endpoint restores the idea of a bound. The human's طغيان is therefore a deformation of the measure by which the human was formed.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and apportioning supplies the created limit that can later be exceeded.
Paring a hard thing into level form gives the measure a material shaping image.
Exceeding the limit in rebellion supplies the direct breach of created measure.
Overwhelming water supplies a material image of force escaping its bounds.
The endpoint at which a thing terminates supplies the boundary demanded after overflow.

structural_cues: The abrupt كَلَّا at 96:6 turns from teaching and formation to human excess.
The later conditional لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ makes failure to reach a limit explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, leveling, limit-crossing, floodlike force, and endpoint; I infer that moral excess is a loss of created proportion. The live alternative is that creation and rebellion are sequential topics without a shared material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Measured creation describes how the human receives form.
changed_reading.after: Measured creation also establishes the human's proper bounds, so transgression reads as overflowing and deforming one's created proportion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The clinging and minimally sustained origin becomes a direct rebuttal to perceived self-sufficiency. Return closes the false interval of autonomy: a being that began by depending on another does not become source-free merely by seeing itself as enough.

activation_trace.role: Clinging to another supplies the original relation of dependence.
Scant support sufficient for life makes dependence economic and bodily as well as spatial.
Self-sufficiency supplies the later claim that contradicts the focus origin.
Returning to what was supplies the reversal of imagined independence.

structural_cues: 96:6 repeats ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ before 96:7 gives self-sufficiency as the reason for excess.
96:8 immediately answers the autonomy claim with return to the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet and syntax supply dependent clinging, self-sufficiency, and return; I infer that 96:2 functions as a suppressed premise against 96:7. It may also remain a remote origin statement without deliberate polemical recall.

changed_reading.before: The origin from عَلَقٍ is a past fact with no direct role in the later warning.
changed_reading.after: The origin is the warning's latent premise: self-sufficiency is a misreading by a creature whose first condition was attachment and provision from elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human branch as perceiving awareness and as the little human image in the pupil is activated by repeated seeing and knowing. The focus human becomes both observer and image under observation: self-sight can misrecognize dependence as autonomy, while divine sight reopens accountable visibility.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving by sight, sense, or hearing supplies the human as an awareness-bearing subject.
The human image in the pupil supplies the human as an object lodged in another gaze.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the recognition the transgressor lacks.
View, appearance, and mirror supply the self-image through which sufficiency is misread.
Vision by eye or insight supplies the encompassing counter-gaze.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from seeing oneself self-sufficient to knowing that God sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perception, a pupil-image, mirror or view, disclosed knowledge, and sight; I infer an observer-observed circuit around ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ. The pupil image may remain only a lexical outlier rather than an intended optical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ is only the biological species produced from attachment.
changed_reading.after: The created human is also a perceiving and perceived image whose ethical crisis begins in a false act of self-recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Passive bodily attachment becomes contested allegiance. One human restrains a worshipper; servanthood names submissive relation; the final refusal of obedience rejects that coercive hold; bending low and drawing near enact a chosen bond. The issue is not whether the created human depends, but which relation will organize that dependence.

activation_trace.role: Clinging or fastening supplies the focus condition that becomes an ethical relation.
Game caught in a snare supplies the coercive version of attachment.
Restraint from action supplies the oppressor's attempt to hold another.
Worship and submissive obedience supply the rival relation under contest.
Compliance and obedience supply the bond explicitly refused to the restrainer.
Bowing the head supplies an embodied acceptance of the alternative relation.
Nearness rather than distance supplies the result of chosen submission.

structural_cues: 96:9-10 makes prohibition govern a worshipper's action.
96:19 answers with three coordinated imperatives: do not obey him, bow, and approach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clinging, snaring, restraint, submission, obedience, bowing, and nearness; I infer that attachment is the mechanism shared by biological origin and contested allegiance. The ritual and coercive relations can also remain distinct without that unifying anthropology.

changed_reading.before: Attachment belongs only to the human's prenatal past.
changed_reading.after: Attachment persists as the human condition, but context distinguishes coercive capture from freely enacted dependence that produces nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relational baseline acquires a reversible direction. A human made through familiarity and heart-fastening can turn away; the final command to approach restores motion toward relation. The context makes attachment neither automatic nor merely sentimental but a capacity that can be refused and renewed.

activation_trace.role: Familiar comfort that removes estrangement supplies relational human presence.
Love fastening to the heart supplies affective attachment.
Turning away supplies the active reversal of attachment.
Drawing near supplies the counter-motion that renews relation.

structural_cues: 96:19 ends the surah window with an imperative of approach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies familiarity, heart-attachment, turning away, and nearness; I infer a relational trajectory from origin through estrangement to renewed approach. The ordinary senses of social comfort and spatial nearness remain separate live readings.

changed_reading.before: Relational attachment is a stable trait installed at creation.
changed_reading.after: Created relationality is directional and vulnerable: the human can turn away from attachment and can be summoned back into nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The caught or clinging source is reversed onto the finished body. What begins as life caught and held becomes a person still catchable at the forelock, while the answering force pushes back and prevents. Bodily accountability thus exposes the continuity of creaturely contingency.

activation_trace.role: Game caught in a snare supplies the focus image of an origin held fast.
Complete visible bodily form supplies the later body on which the reversal lands.
Taking by the forelock supplies the later act of catching the formed human.
The forelock and its seizure localize accountability at a bodily attachment point.
Pushing, striking, and preventing supply the counterforce that defeats presumed bodily sovereignty.

structural_cues: 96:15-16 repeats the forelock and then predicates falsehood and error of it.
96:17-18 answers one summoned collective with another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies caught prey, completed body, forelock seizure, and repelling force; I infer a reversal from caught origin to catchable agent. The direct punishment image does not require prenatal recall, so the continuity remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: The human leaves the vulnerable clinging state behind upon attaining complete form.
changed_reading.after: The later seizure reveals that completed human agency never escapes the catchability already imaged in its origin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fabrication branch of خ ل ق is not substituted for the focus verb; it is activated contrastively. Divine bringing-into-being stands against the human production of a false self-account, and the lying, erring forelock embodies that counterfeit autonomy.

activation_trace.role: Real originating and bringing into being supplies the primary force of the focus verb.
Fabricated false speech supplies a dormant contrary possibility within the same root inventory.
Contradiction of truth activates the false-making side of the contrast.
Missing what is right supplies the deviation produced by the fabricated self-account.

structural_cues: 96:13 first pairs denial with turning away.
96:16 transfers lying and error onto the forelock after the threat of seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both real origination and false fabrication under خ ل ق, followed by explicit lying and missing the right; I infer an antithesis between being truly made and falsely self-authored. The focus verb itself should still be rendered as creation, not fabrication.

changed_reading.before: خَلَقَ only reports who made the human.
changed_reading.after: خَلَقَ also destabilizes the human's fabricated story of self-sufficiency: the truly made creature becomes a false maker of its own account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates branch-distant images under the repeated reading imperative and the final command to approach. It remains anchored because the focus branch explicitly names conception taking hold, while the context branches explicitly name a womb gathering pregnancy and the nearness of birth. Render it only as a latent gestational arc, never as a replacement translation of ٱقْرَأْ or ٱقْتَرِب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَلَقٍ names conception taking hold at 96:2.

activation_trace.role: Conception taking hold supplies the middle stage of the proposed arc.
A womb gathering a pregnancy supplies the enclosing beginning.
The nearness of birth supplies a possible endpoint to the gestational sequence.

changed_reading.before: 96:2 is an isolated snapshot of embryonic origin.
changed_reading.after: 96:2 may occupy the middle of a latent arc: pregnancy is gathered, conception takes hold, and birth draws near.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This social-juridical reading is surprising because it carries عَلَقٍ from biological attachment into claim, dispute, and collective power. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit clinging-claim branch and is reinforced by contextual claim and council branches. Render it as an analogy for how human power accretes, not as the lexical sense of عَلَقٍ in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus عَلَقٍ inventory includes a quarrel or claim that adheres to its bearer.

activation_trace.role: A claim or dispute clinging to a person supplies the focus-side social adhesion.
Human presence as one or a group supplies the scale shift from person to collective.
Claiming a right or affiliation supplies the assertion around which allies gather.
A council or assembled group supplies the institutional body of the clinging claim.

changed_reading.before: The human comes from a small biological attachment and later happens to join a group.
changed_reading.after: The focus attachment can foreshadow how a human claim fastens to a bearer and gathers a social body around itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عَلَقٍ is normally carried by its embryonic and clinging images, not by the branch for a precious guarded object. It remains anchored in an explicit focus branch and gains contextual resonance from what is dear and from favored nearness. Render it as a value-reversal possibility: the dependent origin may be cherished, not as a claim that the noun literally means jewel or treasure here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus عَلَقٍ inventory includes a precious thing to which its owner clings.

activation_trace.role: A precious guarded thing supplies positive value within the otherwise vulnerable origin.
What is dear and honored supplies contextual confirmation of cherished value.
The favored nearness of intimates supplies a possible destination for the precious held origin.

changed_reading.before: The source is cited only to humble the human through lowliness.
changed_reading.after: The source can simultaneously humble through dependence and confer value as something held precious and invited toward favored nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain ecological activation built from several distant packet branches, so it is especially vulnerable to overstatement. It remains anchored in the focus branch for scant sustenance that keeps life going and gains a coherent support chain from feeding-growth, good rain-fed vegetation, dew or pasture, and prepared pasture or fruit. Render it only as a material analogy for dependent life, not as an alternative lexical translation of the contextual words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَلَقٍ carries the branch image of a little sustenance by which a creature continues living.

activation_trace.role: Minimal subsistence supplies the dependent life that the ecological chain sustains.
The non-dominant feeding and growth image supplies development through provision.
Good vegetation and rain supply abundance beyond the minimal ration.
Dew-fed plant and pasture supply the material field of nourishment.
Pasture and fruit becoming ready supply an environment made receptive to life.

changed_reading.before: The human's dependent origin is confined to an interior embryonic event.
changed_reading.after: The origin can also open onto a subsistence ecology in which life persists through growth, rain, pasture, and provision it does not produce alone.

strongest_changes: The attached and minimally sustained origin becomes a direct rebuttal to the human's later perception of self-sufficiency.
Measured formation becomes an ethical measure, making transgression an overflow beyond the proportion by which the human was formed.
Passive prenatal attachment becomes contested allegiance, with coercive capture refused and embodied dependence redirected into prostration and nearness.
Reading, marking, teaching, and the pen make physical creation coexist with the making of a perceptible and teachable human.
summary.what_was_special: The packet generated several mechanisms that remain distinct rather than collapsing into one gloss: gestational gathering and growth, inscription and legibility, bounded form and overflow, dependence and false autonomy, observer and observed image, coercive versus chosen attachment, and the reversal from caught origin to seized body. Split-root branches for visible marking and feeding-growth materially changed the reconstruction rather than being discarded.
remaining_uncertainties: The womb-gathering and approaching-birth branches form an unusually tight gestational arc, but their distance from the ordinary contextual senses makes intentional activation uncertain.
The pupil-image, clinging-claim, precious-object, and subsistence branches remain anchored yet should stay exploratory rather than govern translation.
The contrast between true creation and fabricated selfhood may be a rhetorical activation of the root inventory rather than a live lexical coloration of خَلَقَ itself.
The common mechanism of attachment across embryology, social restraint, worship, and nearness is abductively coherent but not required by syntax alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. The human is read as visible presence produced from hidden attachment. Evidence: `ء ن س B001` visible human presence over against hidden/wild beings; `ع ل ق B003` clotted blood/leech-like attachment; `ع ل ق B009` conception taking hold; `خ ل ق B002` bringing into being. Structural cue: the first named created object is `ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ`, and its source is a singular indefinite `عَلَقٍ`. Mechanism: public human presence is grounded in a small clinging, blood-like, womb-bound origin. Abductive move: the packet supplies the biological/clinging branches; I infer that the ayah compresses visibility from invisibility and autonomy from dependence. Reading change: “human” no longer reads as an independent subject but as a dependent emergence from attachment.

2. `عَلَقٍ` activates not only embryo/clot but also clinging claim and snare. Evidence: `ع ل ق B001` clinging/hanging, `ع ل ق B005` quarrel or claim fastening to someone, `ع ل ق B011` game caught in a snare, and later 96:9-10 the one who restrains a praying servant. Structural cue: after the origin in clinging, the packet later shows a social actor clinging to another's worship by obstruction. Mechanism: attachment can be life-giving origin or coercive entanglement. Abductive move: the packet supplies a root with biological and legal/social branches; I infer that later obstruction reactivates the negative side of attachment. Reading change: the ayah becomes the seed of the whole conflict: the creature born by attachment later misuses attachment as control.

3. The “from clinging” origin undercuts the self-sufficiency of 96:7. Evidence: `ع ل ق B006` meager subsistence to get by and `غ ن ي B001/B002` self-sufficiency/sufficing. Structural cue: 96:2 precedes 96:7 in the same human sequence: created from dependence, then sees himself independent. Mechanism: the later claim of sufficiency is exposed by the earlier material origin. Abductive move: the packet gives origin and later self-assessment; I infer polemical contrast. Reading change: 96:2 becomes an anti-arrogance premise, not only an anthropology statement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later forelock scene made `عَلَقٍ` surprisingly bodily again: the body first clings in hidden formation, then the forelock is seized in public exposure. The same vulnerable embodiment that begins life becomes the point where false authority is checked.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Constitutive dependence rather than a discarded first stage.** `ع ل ق:B001` supplies something clinging to or hanging from another, and `ع ل ق:B009` supplies conception taking hold. The same human is taught in 96:5, crosses bounds in 96:6, and sees himself as self-sufficient in 96:7 (`غ ن ي:B001`). The attachment branch functions as the human’s dependency architecture; the later self-assessment is its exact reversal. I infer that origin remains diagnostic of present status rather than becoming irrelevant after growth. The ayah therefore reads as a standing contradiction of imagined independence.

2. **Formation as a passage from attachment into proportioned presence.** `خ ل ق:B001` supplies measuring, `خ ل ق:B002` bringing into being, and `خ ل ق:B003` complete, well-proportioned form; `ع ل ق:B003` supplies congealed blood and a blood-sucking attached body. The sequence continues from this compact attached material to instruction by pen and acquired knowledge (96:4–5). I infer that the juxtaposed stages describe one formative trajectory. `خلق` then highlights transformation and proportioning, while `علق` keeps the materially dependent starting condition visible inside the finished human.

3. **The human as a perceiving image who can misread himself (exploratory).** `ء ن س:B002` supplies perception entering awareness, and `ء ن س:B005` the small human image visible in the pupil. In 96:5–7, `الإنسان` repeats before the reflexive `رآه`: the human learns, then sees himself as sufficient. The eye-image branch acts as a mirror model in which a visible image is mistaken for the whole perceiving self. I infer, more tentatively, that the lexical eye-image sharpens the reflexive grammar. The fixed `الإنسان` can thus carry an ironic vulnerability: the perceiver may absolutize his own image.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 96:7 supplied the decisive retrospective reversal: the being made from clinging `علق` judges himself independent. Its reflexive `رآه` also made the pupil-image branch `ء ن س:B005` visible, while 96:4–5 confirmed that attachment opens into a teachable developmental sequence. The later context therefore preserved dependence as a present diagnosis rather than a superseded biological stage.

findings.text: Yapışarak tutunan başlangıç, geride kalmış bir biyolojik evre değil, insanın kendini yeterli sanmasını sürekli yalanlayan bağımlılık yapısıdır.
İnsan, gizli ve yapışık bir maddeden ölçülü, görünür bir varlığa geçen oluşum süreci içinde gösterilir.
Hayat veren yapışma, ileride namaz kılanı engelleyen kişinin başkasına ilişip onu denetleme çabasına dönüşen olumsuz bir bağlanma ihtimalini de taşır.
İnsanın gözbebeğindeki küçük görüntü çağrışımı, kendini gören kişinin kendi görüntüsünü bütün gerçeklik sanması ihtimalini açar.
Sonraki perçem sahnesi, gizli oluşumda tutunarak başlayan bedenin kamusal alanda da denetlenebilir ve savunmasız kaldığını geriye dönük olarak açığa çıkarır.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **96:2.** خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ — Birincil okuma: İnsan, görünür bir varlık olarak yapışan kan/pıhtı ve rahimde tutunan başlangıçtan yaratılmıştır. Bağlam bunu özgür ve kendi kendine yeter bir özne değil, kökeninde bağlılık taşıyan bir varlık diye okutur; aynı “yapışma” daha sonra başkasının ibadetine musallat olan zorlayıcı ilişkiye de dönüşür. {خ ل ق B002; ء ن س B001; ع ل ق B001; ع ل ق B003; ع ل ق B009; ع ل ق B011; غ ن ي B001}
butuncul_okuma_line.reading_text_tr: İnsan, görünür bir varlık olarak yapışan kan/pıhtı ve rahimde tutunan başlangıçtan yaratılmıştır. Bağlam bunu özgür ve kendi kendine yeter bir özne değil, kökeninde bağlılık taşıyan bir varlık diye okutur; aynı “yapışma” daha sonra başkasının ibadetine musallat olan zorlayıcı ilişkiye de dönüşür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something hidden or unknown becomes apprehensible through instruction, perception, inquiry, indication, or controlled disclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel extends from pedagogy and eyesight to banners, landmarks, appointments, and verification procedures.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Teaching, Reading, and Inscription
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A knowledgeable source gathers words, teaches a human recipient, and fixes instruction with a prepared writing implement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathered recitation `ق ر ء:B001/m01`; divinely grounded learning `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; acquired knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; writing stylus `ق ل م:B003/m01`; human learner `ء ن س:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Recitation supplies the ordered verbal material, teaching transfers it, and the pared stylus gives it durable form. The human figure is both the object of creation and the recipient whose prior lack is changed into knowledge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something hidden or unknown becomes apprehensible through instruction, perception, inquiry, indication, or controlled disclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel extends from pedagogy and eyesight to banners, landmarks, appointments, and verification procedures.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Eye, Pupil, and Sustained Regard
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Detection begins with the eye, focuses through the dark pupil, and can settle into a prolonged, quiet gaze.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: visual perception `ر ء ي:B001/m01`; sensory detection `ء ن س:B002/m01`; dark pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`; sustained gaze `س ج د:B005/m01`; dark-red or black tinge `س ف ع:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is an optical mechanism rather than a generic cognition cluster: an object is detected, received in the pupil, and held under an unbroken gaze. The chromatic branch sharpens the concrete blackness through which sight is imagined.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something hidden or unknown becomes apprehensible through instruction, perception, inquiry, indication, or controlled disclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel extends from pedagogy and eyesight to banners, landmarks, appointments, and verification procedures.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Showing, Detecting, and Verifying
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A concealed condition is deliberately shown, sensed by an observer, and held long enough for verification.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate showing `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; sensory detection `ء ن س:B002/m01`; detention for verification `ق ر ء:B010/m01`; manifest appearance `ن د و:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Showing is the initiating act, detection is the observer's uptake, and temporary detention protects the judgment from haste. The image of something becoming so manifest that it seems to call out completes the disclosure process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A representation is asserted, tested against what is known, and either sustained as truth or exposed as fabrication.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Falsehood expands into authorship, attached legal claims, imputation, and a self that protects its own deception.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Claim, Lineage, and Attached Litigation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A party asserts a right or affiliation, the assertion adheres to an opponent as a dispute, and speech is returned in contest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: asserted right `د ع و:B002/m01`; attached lawsuit `ع ل ق:B005/m01`; fabricated pleading `خ ل ق:B007/m02`; contested reply `ر ج ع:B005/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The claim initiates a social and legal attachment rather than a neutral statement. Once it adheres to another party, fabrication and reply become opposing operations within one dispute.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal and human life proceeds through mating, conception, gestation, visible signs, birth, milk, fostering, and separation of the young.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sequence includes estrus, pregnancy verification, milk interruption, foster care, and weaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mating and Conception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An animal enters estrus, the male mounts, and a conception becomes fixed in the womb.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: estrus `ق ر ء:B009/m01`; mounting male `س م و:B003/m01`; fixed conception `ع ل ق:B009/m01`; checking pregnancy `ر ج ع:B013/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Estrus supplies reproductive readiness, mounting supplies contact, and the fastening sense of conception supplies the outcome. Rechecking the animal turns an initially hidden event into a monitored state.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal and human life proceeds through mating, conception, gestation, visible signs, birth, milk, fostering, and separation of the young.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sequence includes estrus, pregnancy verification, milk interruption, foster care, and weaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gestation, Bodily Signs, and Imminent Birth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The womb gathers its contents, pregnancy becomes visible, and detention in gestation ends as birth approaches.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathered womb contents `ق ر ء:B003/m01`; visible pregnancy `ر ء ي:B010/m01`; gestational holding `ق ر ء:B004/m01`; imminent birth `ق ر ب:B012/m01`; menstrual sign `ر ء ي:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gathering and holding describe the interior process, menstrual and visible-pregnancy signs disclose its condition, and nearness changes from spatial relation into the approach of delivery.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal and human life proceeds through mating, conception, gestation, visible signs, birth, milk, fostering, and separation of the young.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sequence includes estrus, pregnancy verification, milk interruption, foster care, and weaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Milk, Fosterage, and Maternal Substitution
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A caregiver or surrogate tends the young while milk starts, is withheld, or fails.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: foster caregiver `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; first call of milk `د ع و:B003/m01`; surrogate dam withholding milk `ع ل ق:B010/m01`; milk ceasing `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Fosterage provides the social role, while the milk branches describe the resource on which care depends. Initiation, withholding, and cessation make nourishment a changing process rather than a static possession.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social continuity is created and altered through marriage, return or separation, descent, covenant, clientage, and care for dependents.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel moves from bridal transfer to suspended marriage, foster relations, oath-bound alliance, manumission, and household surety.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Suspension, Separation, and Marital Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A spouse is left between marriage and singleness, may become fully separated, or may be restored to the household.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: suspended wife `ع ل ق:B008/m01`; marital return `ر ج ع:B004/m01`; spouseless separation `ق ل م:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Suspension names the unstable middle state, separation resolves it toward singleness, and return resolves it toward renewed household membership.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A worshipper recognizes sovereignty, adopts a posture of service, and approaches through prayer, prostration, offering, and consecrated preparation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Worship opens into sacred places, sanctuary livestock, fragrant anointment, aloeswood, and perfume grinding.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Offering and Sanctuary Approach
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A gift or animal is brought near, directed toward sanctuary, and converted into an offering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: approach-offering `ق ر ب:B005/m01`; sanctuary animal `ه د ي:B005/m01`; bestowed gift `ء ل ي:B012/m01`; devotional companionship `ء ن س:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Nearness becomes ritual transfer: a gift is directed toward a sacred destination, and the offered animal embodies that movement. Companionship supplies the relational aim of restored nearness.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: People become a public body by gathering, calling, deliberating, assigning rank, or dispersing into absence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The social field includes multitudes, empty dwellings, intimate retainers, court privilege, leadership, and delegated office.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Elite, Leader, and Court Intimate
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A selected person advances at the front, gains privileged proximity, and serves as an intimate of power.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: chosen elite `ن ص ي:B003/m01`; leading front `ه د ي:B003/m01`; court favorite `ق ر ب:B004/m01`; intimate confidant `ء ن س:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Selection differentiates the elite, precedence gives that person a leading position, and nearness to authority becomes court privilege. Intimacy describes the social access produced by rank.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Persons and goods acquire social value through honor, attachment, generosity, reciprocal giving, praise, and rivalry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Esteem attaches to treasured objects, gracious answers, gifts seeking recompense, public boasting, and reputational sound.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Precious Attachment and Veneration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A valued object or person is held close, treated as precious, and publicly honored.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: precious attachment `ع ل ق:B007/m01`; beloved rarity `ك ر م:B010/m01`; veneration `ع ب د:B006/m01`; honorable worth `ك ر م:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Attachment supplies possession and emotional closeness, preciousness supplies scarcity, and veneration converts private value into public treatment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relations are organized by direction, distance, contact, return, succession, and arrival at a limit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Spatial nearness expands into bodily facing, residence, temporal imminence, race order, and goal attainment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Facing and Direction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body presents its inward side, turns its face, and adopts a direction or intended course.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: inward-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`; turning the face `و ل ي:B006/m01`; direction `ه د ي:B002/m01`; attentive sight `ر ء ي:B001/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Orientation begins in anatomy, becomes a deliberate turn, and culminates in a chosen direction. Sight aligns attention with the body's facing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action depends on fitness, acquired capacity, effort, provision, and the point at which need is adequately met.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel includes vocation, beginning a task, food need, subsistence fodder, surety, and voluntary exertion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Aptitude, Entitlement, and Undertaking
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A suitable agent is judged fit, gains priority, and begins the assigned action.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fitness `خ ل ق:B005/m01`; beginning an undertaking `ع ل ق:B016/m01`; entitlement `و ل ي:B008/m01`; intended course `ه د ي:B002/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Fitness answers who can act, entitlement answers who should act, intention gives the action direction, and commencement changes potential into execution.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Action depends on fitness, acquired capacity, effort, provision, and the point at which need is adequately met.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel includes vocation, beginning a task, food need, subsistence fodder, surety, and voluntary exertion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Subsistence and Provision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Food need motivates effort, while a small provision or ready pasture sustains dependents and animals.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: food need `ز ب ن:B006/m01`; minimal subsistence `ع ل ق:B006/m01`; wealth and dependents `ق ر ء:B013/m01`; ready pasture `ط و ع:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Need is the deficit, provision is the portable remedy, and pasture is the environmental remedy. Dependents make adequacy a household responsibility rather than an individual state.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water descends, surges, gathers, is drawn or carried, and turns ground into pasture and ripened growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The hydrological scene includes cloud cover, seasonal rain, terminal pools, wells, pulleys, waterskins, herd watering, and overripe fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Well, Pulley, and Waterskin
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water is retained in an excavation, lifted by suspended gear, and transferred into a portable skin.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: water-holding well `خ ل ق:B011/m01`; suspended pulley `ع ل ق:B002/m01`; waterskin `ق ر ب:B009/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The well supplies storage, the pulley supplies mechanical lift, and the waterskin supplies transport. Abundance describes the resource before it is divided into usable loads.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Internal condition becomes legible through breath, blood, pain, bodily marks, weakness, or fullness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel includes lung disease, epidemic terrain, menstruation, leech treatment, cleft tissue, flank pain, hip sockets, and corpulence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Blood Sign and Therapeutic Leech
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Thick blood or cyclical discharge is observed, and a leech or tissue intervention is used to draw blood.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: clot or thick blood `ع ل ق:B003/m01`; medicinal leech `ع ل ق:B003/m02`; menstrual sign `ر ء ي:B007/m01`; leech bloodletting `ع ل ق:B012/m02`; cleft upper lip `ع ل م:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Blood appears first as substance and diagnostic sign, then the leech changes role from bloodlike creature to therapeutic instrument. The cleft or treated tissue provides the bodily site of intervention.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and materials are covered, colored, worn, cut, marked, and ornamented so that surface appearance carries social meaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel joins bodices, dyed and iridescent cloth, fraying, recycled material, tattoo lines, combed hair, necklaces, and the neck itself.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dyed, Iridescent, and Deceptive Cloth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Cloth is dyed or woven with changing color, fitted to the body, and made capable of overstating its quality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dyed garment `س ف ع:B007/m01`; deceptive cloth `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`; iridescent fabric `ق ل م:B010/m01`; small bodice `ع ل ق:B015/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Dye and iridescence create visual attraction, the bodice gives the fabric bodily placement, and deceptive appearance explains how surface can claim a value the material does not possess.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and materials are covered, colored, worn, cut, marked, and ornamented so that surface appearance carries social meaning.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel joins bodices, dyed and iridescent cloth, fraying, recycled material, tattoo lines, combed hair, necklaces, and the neck itself.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Necklace, Neck, and Precious Attachment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A precious ornament is arranged around the neck and marks the wearer's status.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: necklace `ك ر م:B003/m01`; neck `ز ب ن:B008/m01`; precious attachment `ع ل ق:B007/m02`; public honor `ع ب د:B006/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The neck supplies the support, the necklace supplies the object, attachment supplies fixation, and honor supplies the social meaning of wearing it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animals are identified, pursued, trapped, nourished, bred, and tracked through characteristic motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel contains snares, raptors, shrikes, hyenas, lambs, herds, migration, halted flight, racing order, and hoof care.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hunt, Trap, and Captured Prey
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hunter goes out, sets a fixed snare, and holds an animal that has become entangled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: going out to hunt `س م و:B006/m01`; snared prey `ع ل ق:B011/m01`; fixed hunting trap `ص ل و:B004/m01`; quarry that runs then halts `ك ذ ب:B007/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The hunt supplies the agent and purpose, the fixed trap supplies the mechanism, and entanglement supplies the capture outcome. The quarry's run and halt describe the movement interrupted by capture.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animals are identified, pursued, trapped, nourished, bred, and tracked through characteristic motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel contains snares, raptors, shrikes, hyenas, lambs, herds, migration, halted flight, racing order, and hoof care.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Raptors, Shrikes, and Foraging
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Predatory birds range over a food field and secure the subsistence on which they live.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: falcon or hawk `ع ل م:B006/m01`; shrike `و ق ي:B005/m01`; subsistence portion `ع ل ق:B006/m02`; fodder plant `ن ص ي:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The named birds supply agents, pasture supplies hunting terrain, and subsistence supplies the functional outcome. The channel is ecological rather than a simple list of species.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material or circumstance is overtaken by force, producing controlled transformation, scorching, collapse, or calamity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel contrasts cooking and aromatic preparation with destructive heat, cascading ruin, bodily breakdown, doom, and public disgrace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Vicissitude, Doom, and Disgrace
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Adverse events attach themselves to a person, culminate in calamity, and leave a public condition of shame.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: vicissitudes `د ع و:B006/m01`; attached calamity or doom `ع ل ق:B014/m01`; overwhelming punishment `ط غ و:B005/m01`; disgrace `ن د و:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `د ع و` 96:17-18; `ع ل ق` 96:2; `ط غ و` has no separate surface token; `ن د و` 96:17
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Vicissitude supplies repeated adversity, attachment makes the calamity inescapably personal, punishment supplies culmination, and disgrace supplies the social aftermath.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A figure appears to perception without ordinary bodily presence, as dream image, reflection, spirit, or unseen counterpart.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes the dream image inside perception from the spirit or apparition opposed to ordinary human visibility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dream Image
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sleeping perceiver receives a formed image that appears inwardly rather than as an external body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dream vision `ر ء ي:B003/m01`; human image in the dark pupil `ء ن س:B005/m02`; reflected appearance `ر ء ي:B006/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Dream supplies the mode of perception, the pupil-image supplies an inward visual carrier, and reflected appearance gives the dream a coherent figure despite the absence of an external body.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A figure appears to perception without ordinary bodily presence, as dream image, reflection, spirit, or unseen counterpart.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel distinguishes the dream image inside perception from the spirit or apparition opposed to ordinary human visibility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Spirit and Apparition
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An unseen being or image becomes perceptible at the boundary between human presence and the nonhuman unseen.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: spirit or apparition `ر ء ي:B008/m01`; human contrasted with the unseen `ء ن س:B001/m02`; apparition-like pupil image `ء ن س:B005/m03`; misleading cultic power `ط غ ي:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The human/unseen contrast establishes the boundary, apparition crosses it as perceived presence, and the cultic-power motif shows how such presence can be elevated into a misleading authority.
